list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural with 1a and 1b, this trinuclear erbium complex contains three μ2-methyl, one μ3-methyl, and one μ3-methylidene bridge.

synthesis.procedure: AlMe3 solution was added slowly to the stirring erbium benzamidinate precursor in toluene under exclusion of air and water. The mixture was stirred at ambient temperature, concentrated, washed with cold hexane, redissolved in toluene, and concentrated again.
synthesis.time: about 10 hours stirring; three days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove toluene under vacuum, wash twice with 2 mL cold hexane, redissolve in toluene, concentrate under reduced pressure, and leave standing to obtain pink crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Benzonitrile addition to the bridging methylidene forms a 1-aza-allyl dianion coordinated to the trinuclear yttrium core in an η1:η1:η3 mode; the methyl bridges remain.

synthesis.procedure: A benzonitrile solution in toluene was added slowly to a stirring toluene solution of 1a under exclusion of air and water. After stirring at ambient temperature, the yellow solution was concentrated.
synthesis.time: about 24 hours stirring; four days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrate the yellow solution under vacuum to saturation and leave standing to harvest yellow crystals.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion, PhCN reactivity; Scheme 2
Experimental, synthesis of 2b referring to 2a procedure

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The lutetium benzonitrile-addition product contains the newly formed bridging 1-aza-allyl unit and retained methyl bridges.

synthesis.procedure: Treat 1b with benzonitrile in toluene by the procedure described for 2a, under exclusion of air and water.
synthesis.time: about 24 hours stirring and four days standing, by the 2a procedure
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization analogous to 2a; a colorless crystalline product was obtained.

Experimental, synthesis of 3a

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Phenylacetylene reaction converts the methylidene-containing core into a trinuclear complex bearing a cis-1-phenyl-1-propenyl dianion alongside methyl bridges.

synthesis.procedure: Add phenylacetylene in toluene slowly to a stirring toluene solution of 1a under exclusion of air and water. Stir, remove solvent under vacuum, and wash the residue.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove toluene under vacuum and wash twice with 2 mL cold hexane to obtain yellow powder.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion, phenylacetylene reactivity; Fig. 3

X-ray crystallographic analysis

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: X-ray analysis identifies a cis-1-phenyl-1-propenyl dianion bound to the three lutetium ions in a μ3-η1:η3 mode, with methyl bridges retained.

synthesis.procedure: React 1b with phenylacetylene by the toluene procedure described for 3a, under exclusion of air and water.
synthesis.time: 10 hours stirring by the 3a procedure; three days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Obtain yellow powder as for 3a; concentrate its toluene solution to saturation and stand at room temperature for three days to harvest yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Protonolysis of the μ3-methyl group gives a trinuclear core retaining its μ3-methylidene and three μ2-methyl bridges and bearing a μ3-trimethylsilylacetylide group.

synthesis.procedure: Add trimethylsilylacetylene in toluene slowly to a stirring toluene solution of 1a under exclusion of air and water. Stir at ambient temperature and remove toluene under vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove solvent under vacuum to obtain yellow powder; recrystallize from toluene at ambient temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The lutetium analogue of 4a contains a μ3-trimethylsilylacetylide group, retained μ3-methylidene, and three μ2-methyl bridges.

synthesis.procedure: React 1b with trimethylsilylacetylene in toluene by the procedure described for 4a, under exclusion of air and water.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove toluene under vacuum to obtain yellow powder, as for 4a.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion, CS2 reactivity; Scheme 2
Experimental, synthesis of 5a

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The trinuclear yttrium product retains a μ3-methylidene and two μ2-methyl groups and incorporates an ethene-1,1-dithiolate ligand formed through methyl activation by CS2.

synthesis.procedure: Add CS2 in toluene slowly to a stirring toluene solution of 1a under exclusion of air and water. Stir overnight at ambient temperature, remove solvent under vacuum, and wash the residue.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove solvent under vacuum, wash oily residue twice with 2 mL cold hexane, then remove hexane under vacuum to obtain yellow powder.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The X-ray structure shows a trinuclear lutetium core retaining a μ3-methylidene and two μ2-methyl groups. A planar ethene-1,1-dithiolate dianion bridges the three lutetium ions through its two sulfur atoms.

synthesis.procedure: Treat 1b with CS2 in toluene by the procedure described for 5a, under exclusion of air and water.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air- and moisture-excluding Schlenk or glovebox technique
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Work-up analogous to 5a; obtained as a yellow crystalline product.
